title: GTA 6 Cars Can Run Out of Gas: A Banshee Lasts 18 Minutes ⛽ #Shorts
description:
Yes, GTA 6 cars burn fuel. Kotaku timed full tanks: a Banshee sports car ran dry in 18 min 31 s, an older pickup lasted 29 min 8 s, and an electric car about 20 min. The game warns you at half a tank and again near empty, refueling is a ~10-second cutscene (Rockstar North's Rob Nelson: "pretty fast for a fill-up"), and a stolen car only has whatever fuel was left in it.

Sources: Kotaku, "We Tested How Long It Takes To Run Out Of Gas In GTA 6" (Nov 18, 2026); Jalopnik; PC Gamer / Dexerto (Rob Nelson quote).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look, official screenshot). Some scenes are illustrative.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
